sources.document_title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics SPECIFICATION (Reference Sheet) for CL10A475KO8NNNC, Multi-layer Ceramic Capacitor, with appended MLCC Product Manual
sources.locator: Page 1 title block (Supplier, Samsung P/N, Product, Description), Section A Samsung Part Number decode table and Section B Structure & Dimension table
sources.evidence_extract: Supplier: Samsung electro-mechanics; Samsung P/N: CL10A475KO8NNNC; Product: Multi-layer Ceramic Capacitor; Description: CAP, 4.7uF, 16V, +/-10%, X5R, 0603. Decode: CL series; size 0603 (inch code) L 1.60+/-0.10 mm, W 0.80+/-0.10 mm; dielectric X5R; capacitance 4.7uF; tolerance +/-10%; rated voltage 16V; thickness 0.80+/-0.10 mm; inner electrode Ni, termination Cu, plating Ni/Sn 100%; product Normal; packaging Cardboard Type, 7 inch reel, 4K. Section B shows a two-terminal block with end terminations (BW). Hash comparison: A5 baseline: none. A5 recorded no datasheet URL or SHA-256 for C19666 (engineering/a5/passive_evidence/C19666.snapshot.json carries no dataManualUrl/dataManualOfficialLink and engineering/a5/electronics/source_provenance.json has no entry), so there is no A5 hash to compare; bytes inspected now (2026-11-08, HTTP 200, Content-Type application/download, 3011801 bytes, starts %PDF-, 38 pages; GET and the product page's POST form return identical bytes): b2081b0b0d43033ef3aca53f8c56f782c170ac3913a91aa847b74e5f7e6557a9 - no A5 baseline.
